verdict.rationale: Alloy documents outbound webhooks for asynchronous events such as watchlist updates and manual reviews, with signed payloads using a shared secret. It also documents retries on exponential backoff for 24 hours, and webhook settings where a webhook that is auto-disabled after repeated failures can be re-enabled, which indicates registrable HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: an explicit event-type catalog and documented subscription/registration mechanics (API or UI for choosing events), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
